subject: Helios Health: SCIM sync provenance + RBAC ownership & POA
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@helioshealth.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: compliance@helioshealth.com
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: SCIM provisioning logs + RBAC ownership

Hi Camila —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As part of our SIG intake we need a short package showing the provenance of SCIM provisioning activity for our Helios pilot org, and a mapping that ties Redwoods' RBAC roles to our least-privilege owners. Specifically we need: 

- A recent SCIM sync log (delta or snapshot) showing account create/modify/deactivate events for 2026-08-20 through 2026-08-26.
- A CSV or table that maps Redwood role names -> Helios mapped roles -> owner (email).
- One SAML assertion sample (redacted) that demonstrates the NameID and role attribute mapping.
- Short note on where user role ownership lives (UI path / API) and how role changes are audited.

Can you confirm a delivery timeline and whether any of this will contain PII that needs redaction?

Appreciate it — if you want to loop in your security eng I can share exact SIG item numbers.

Best,
Sara
Sara Nguyen
Information Security Manager
Helios Health

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 10:42:00 -07:00

Team — forwarding Helios' ask (below). They want a SCIM sync snapshot for last week + role -> owner mapping and a SAML assertion sample. Quick plan:

- Priyom: can you pull the SCIM sync ndjson snapshot for 2026-08-20 — 2026-08-26 and redact any email addresses if necessary? Helios will accept redacted identifiers but wants event types and timestamps.
- Ben: please pull the canonical RBAC export and produce a CSV mapping our role ids -> display names -> assigned owner email (owner can be team alias). Also include the UI path where owners are set and recent audit rows for owner changes.
- Rishi: can you provide a short paragraph (1-2 bullets) on audit trails — where they are stored, retention, how to query for owner-change events.

Aim to have a packaged zip by Monday EOD PST. Flag if you need anything else.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

On Fri, Aug 27, 2026 at 10:42 AM Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Team — forwarding Helios' ask (below).

I pulled the SCIM snapshot from our audit bucket. Notes:

- File: scim-sync-log-20260826.ndjson — contains event objects with event_type (create/update/deactivate), external_id, source (okta_provisioner), timestamp, actor_id (system/service-account).
- PII: the snapshot includes full email addresses. Per Helios' ask we should produce a redacted version replacing local-part with hash (e.g., alice+redacted@domain.com -> hash_4b7c@domain.com) and keep timestamps, event_type, and external_id intact.
- Retention note: these logs are retained 90 days in the live bucket and then archived for 1 year.

I'll create redacted ndjson and a short manifest that explains columns and the redaction method.

Attachments to internal: scim-sync-log-20260826.ndjson (raw, internal only)

Priyom
Engineering, Platform

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 08:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evidence request: SCIM provisioning logs + RBAC ownership

Camila / Priyom — attaching the RBAC export and the role-owner CSV. Also pulled two recent audit rows for owner changes (2026-06-12, 2026-07-22). Inline notes: 

- Attachment: rbac-role-mapping-v1.csv (roles, role_display_name, owner_email, last_modified)
- Attachment: minimal-PII-redaction-readme.pdf — describes our hashing approach and the fields we considered PII.
- Owner location: Console -> Org Settings -> Access Control -> Roles -> Owner (UI shows owner email; API available at /api/v1/roles/{role_id}).

I will prepare the zip (Helios-friendly) and upload to the shared drive.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Product Security

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@helioshealth.com>
Cc: compliance@helioshealth.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2026 16:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SCIM provisioning logs + RBAC ownership

Sara — thanks for the timeline. We've packaged the deliverables and uploaded them to a Helios-shared folder (link below). Quick summary of what you'll find: 

- scim-sync-log-20260826-redacted.ndjson (redacted by hashing local-part; preserves timestamps, event_type, source, external_id)
- rbac-role-mapping-v1.csv (role_id, role_name, mapped_helios_role, owner_alias)
- sso-saml-assertion-sample.txt (redacted assertion showing NameID and role attribute mapping)
- minimal-PII-redaction-readme.pdf (notes on redaction and retention policy)

Link (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1hx-HeliosComplianceShared
HubSpot deal: HLX-9876

A couple of implementation notes:
- SCIM events are produced by the Okta provisioner; the source field in the ndjson is "okta_provisioner".
- Role ownership is editable via Console -> Org Settings -> Access Control -> Roles and changes are audited with actor, timestamp, and delta. Rishi added a short note in the zip that explains where audit logs are stored and how to query them via our internal audit API.

If you want us to create a short screencast showing owner-change audit queries, happy to do that on request.

Best regards,
Camila Reyes
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
